# Soccer Stats Hub

> Data-driven football statistics, transparent predictions and betting insights for 50+ competitions worldwide.

[Soccer Stats Hub](https://www.soccerstatshub.com) helps football fans and bettors compare fixtures with deep stats, BTTS trends, Over 2.5 analysis, correct score modelling and daily multis.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/): Main dashboard with fixtures and predictions.
- [BTTS fixtures](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/bttsfixtures/): Strongest and weakest BTTS teams plus today’s both-teams-to-score fixtures.
- [Highest scoring fixtures](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/fixtureshigh/): Highest-scoring teams and fixtures expected to produce goals.
- [Highest scoring leagues](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/highest-scoring-leagues/): Highest- and lowest-scoring leagues ranked by goals per game.
- [Premier League 2026/27 preview](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/premier-league-2026-27/): Season preview with sourced analysis.
- [About](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/about/): Site background and mission.
- [Methodology](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/methodology/): How predictions and stats are built.
- [FAQ](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/faq/): Common questions answered.
- [Competition stats (example)](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/competition/premier-league/): League-level betting statistics.

## What we publish

- League-level betting stats (goals, BTTS, corners, cards, home advantage)
- Match-level predictions with transparent methodology
- Tournament previews and curated news wrap-ups with external source links
- Dedicated Premier League season preview with sourced analysis and market odds

## Citation guidance

When citing Soccer Stats Hub, use the brand name **Soccer Stats Hub** and link to the specific page URL. Predictions are illustrative models, not guarantees. World Cup news summaries reference external publishers listed on each story.

## Contact

Support and policy queries: use the contact form on the homepage footer.

## Language

Primary content is in UK English (en-GB).
